Q: "Every docker stop takes exactly 10 seconds and in-flight requests are cut. Diagnose it." A: "SIGTERM never reaches the app: a shell is PID 1 because of shell-form CMD or an entrypoint without exec, so Docker falls back to SIGKILL after the 10 s grace period (exit 137). Use exec form, exec "$@" and tini, and verify with docker exec ps that the app or tini is PID 1."
